transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because the clinic kind of got on my case about how little I've been eating lately. But honestly, most days I just grab a coffee before my shift at the warehouse, and then maybe I'll have a yogurt or just a few bites of something after my GED class. Sitting down for a full, real meal just... it feels like it throws off everything I'm trying to keep in line right now.

When you think about eating a full meal, are you mainly worried about gaining weight or how it might affect your body shape, or is it more about something else, like feeling anxious or not having time?

It's definitely about the weight. Like, if I eat something heavy... say, the fried food someone brings into the break room at work, or if I get a big plate of food at church... I get really scared that it’s going to show on me right away. I'll just keep thinking about it non-stop, and it makes me want to go check the scale as soon as I can to see the damage. So, yeah, it's not really about not having time. It's mostly just worrying about gaining.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, or if you know it, how does your weight now compare to what's typical or healthy for someone your height?

I'm about 5'4", and right now I weigh... well, I know it's lower than what's supposed to be healthy for my height. My work pants are pretty loose on me lately, and people keep telling me I look too thin. But honestly... when I see that number go down, I just feel like I'm finally getting somewhere. I really don't see why I should be pushed to put the weight back on.
Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle, such as your periods becoming irregular or stopping altogether, since you've lost weight?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes like that. My periods have been pretty much the same as they usually are. They haven't stopped or anything.
Have you ever had episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel out of control, or used vomiting, laxatives, or diuretics to prevent weight gain?

No, I haven't done any of that. I don't eat large amounts of food... I actually keep pretty strict control over what I eat, so I don't ever really feel out of control like that. And no, I've never made myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything to lose weight. I just try not to eat much in the first place.
